description: This file manages channel plugin resolution, including catalog lookup, plugin loading, and installation logic within the openclaw project.

classes.name: ChannelPluginSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of channel plugins and setups.

classes.name: ResolveInstallableChannelPluginResult
classes.description: Result type for resolving an installable channel plugin.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveResolvedChannelId
methods.description: Resolves a channel ID from raw input or catalog entry.

methods.name: resolveCatalogChannelEntry
methods.description: Finds a catalog entry matching a raw channel string.

methods.name: findScopedChannelPlugin
methods.description: Finds a plugin in a snapshot by channel ID.

methods.name: isTrustedWorkspaceChannelCatalogEntry
methods.description: Checks if a catalog entry is trusted based on workspace origin and enable state.

methods.name: resolveTrustedCatalogEntry
methods.description: Resolves a trusted catalog entry, considering workspace origin and aliases.

methods.name: loadScopedChannelPlugin
methods.description: Loads a plugin for a specific channel ID and optional plugin ID.

methods.name: resolveInstallableChannelPlugin
methods.description: Main function to resolve or install a channel plugin, supporting support checks and prompting.
